name: Aquila
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Aquila in St. Anton am Arlberg**

Discover the perfect blend of alpine charm and modern luxury at **Aquila**, your home away from home in the heart of the **Tirol** ski and hiking paradise **St. Anton am Arlberg**. Nestled in the picturesque **Lechtal**, this 4-star superior hotel invites you to experience unforgettable moments in one of the most beautiful regions of the Alps.

### **Relax & Unwind**
After an exciting day on the slopes or a refreshing hike through the stunning **Arlberg** landscape, recharge your batteries in our **Spa & Wellness** area. Indulge in a soothing massage, enjoy a sauna session, or simply relax in our outdoor pool with a view of the majestic mountains.

### **Culinary Delights**
Savor authentic **Tirol** flavors in our **Restaurant Aquila**, where our chefs prepare regional specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or fresh trout from the nearby **Lech**. For a cozy evening, our **Bar & Lounge** offers craft cocktails and local beers, perfect for unwinding after a day of adventure.

### **Adventure Awaits**
**St. Anton am Arlberg** is a year-round playground for sports enthusiasts. In winter, world-class ski slopes and snowboarding parks await, while summer transforms the area into a hiker’s and mountain biker’s paradise. Our concierge team is happy to help you plan your next adventure—whether it’s a guided tour of the **Zams** castle ruins or a thrilling descent down the **Pitztal Glacier**.

### **Family-Friendly**
Families will love our **Kids’ Club**, offering supervised activities and games tailored for young guests. Plus, our spacious rooms and suites provide plenty of space for parents and children alike.

### **Location & Accessibility**
Just a short walk from the **St. Anton** village center and the **Patscherkofelbahn**, **Aquila** is perfectly located for easy access to all attractions. Whether you’re here for skiing, hiking, or simply soaking in the alpine atmosphere, **Aquila** ensures a memorable stay in the heart of **Tirol**.

**Book your escape to the Alps today and let Aquila in St. Anton am Arlberg become your home in paradise.**
